page.overview:
Who is Delgado?

Congresswoman Delgado was a United States congresswoman who Claire Dearing tried to persuade to raise support for the Dinosaur Protection Group. She asked Delgado if she wanted her children to grow up in a world without dinosaurs. Although she was successful at winning Congresswoman Delgado's support, immediately after hanging up with her, Claire saw the committee chairman on TV announce that the US would not intervene on Isla Nublar.
